episodes.synopsis: An amnesiac named Elle enters Los Angeles, carrying only a locked data device that may hold the secrets of her past.
episodes.title: City of Angels

episodes.synopsis: Haunted by traumatic memories, Elle recognizes a familiar face. Upon tracking him down she uncovers a shocking truth about herself and her memories.
episodes.title: All We Are Not

episodes.synopsis: With help from the mysterious J, Elle learns more startling truths about the nature of her identity…
episodes.title: The Human Condition

episodes.synopsis: Elle's memories come flooding back, revealing the truth of what happened to her in the desert. Meanwhile, LAPD Officer Davis puts together the clues that will lead her to Black Lotus.
episodes.title: The Doll Hunt

episodes.synopsis: Elle plots her revenge with help from J, but Police Chief Grant has mobilized a massive LAPD manhunt to find and eliminate her.
episodes.title: Pressure

episodes.synopsis: In her quest for revenge, Elle breaks into the home of her next target and is forced to take a hostage. Chief Grant calls in reinforcements.
episodes.title: Persistence of Memory

episodes.synopsis: After learning J's shameful secret, Elle leaves to complete her mission: to kill the last of the Doll Hunt participants.
episodes.title: Reality

episodes.synopsis: Frustrated that no one believes her theory about Black Lotus, Officer Davis lands in hot water while presenting her findings to the department.
episodes.title: The Davis Report

episodes.synopsis: Elle goes after the final target to complete her mission of revenge, the man responsible for the Doll Hunt.
episodes.title: Free Will

episodes.synopsis: As Elle struggles with not knowing which of her memories are real and which are artificial, J opens up about his own past.
episodes.title: Clair de Lune

episodes.synopsis: Desperately lost and searching for peace, Elle hatches a radical plan to put her haunted memories to rest.
episodes.title: All the Best Memories

episodes.synopsis: While Elle has her first encounter with a dangerous new foe, J has his final encounter with his former colleague Marlowe.
episodes.title: Artificial Souls

episodes.synopsis: Left with no other option, Elle faces off against the architect of her suffering.
episodes.title: Time to Die
